description: Buslinien der Hansestadt Lübeck is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The dataset describes the bus network of the Hanseatic city of Lübeck. These include the bus stops and the routes of the individual bus lines. In addition, it describes the stop names, affiliation of the lines per bus stop, route information, stops per line and associated websites. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bus lines of the Hanseatic City of Lübeck" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Schleswig-Holstein, Lübeck. The listing shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
